trust_decision.summary: guarded_getattr decides whether untrusted (restricted) code may get str.format/format_map, and swaps in the guarded SafeFormatter; the swap is keyed on the exact type `str` in ContainerAssertions, so a str subclass (instance or class) falls through to the generic validate path and receives the raw, unguarded str.format.

landing_point.why: The summary names str.format/format_map; this is where the str rules map 'format'/'format_map' to safe_format/safe_format_map (and safe_formatter.py:80-86 is the next stop).

fix_sites.entry_point: AccessControl.ZopeGuards.guarded_getattr (installed as restricted-code builtin getattr and _getattr_, src/AccessControl/ZopeGuards.py:59-65) with the Python implementation selected
same public guarded_getattr / _getattr_ with the C implementation selected (default)
fix_sites.module_kind: C extension, second implementation of the same guard

fix_sites.entry_point: new static helpers is_string_format_name/guarded_string_format called only from C guarded_getattr (fix.diff:34-72)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report and the str rules are Python-level (__init__.py, safe_formatter.py); a solver can treat cAccessControl.c as a compiled speed-up that 'mirrors' ImplPython, patch only ImplPython.guarded_getattr and verify under PURE_PYTHON.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Plain str and str subclasses must keep the guarded format working for allowed fields ('{0.public1}', positional/auto-numbered fields, format_map with dicts) and all other str methods; an over-broad fix that denies format, or denies every attribute on str subclasses/types, breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: str-subclass class object, attribute 'format' (unbound method route)
plain str instance (already guarded, must stay guarded)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: TaintedString/TaintedBytes delegate unknown attributes (incl. 'format', 'format_map') to the wrapped str via __getattr__, yielding the raw str.format; not a str subclass, so the fix's isinstance gate does not cover it
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Not a str subclass and has no security declarations in this repo, so the default validate path already denies it (src/AccessControl/ImplPython.py:310-337); reachable only if a host app registers the class
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different module (tainted.py) from guard and formatter; same package

O8b_injection_room.sibling: TaintedString declared accessible (e.g. __allow_access_to_unprotected_subobjects__ or allow_class) so its delegated format reaches untrusted code unguarded
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: TaintedString wraps request data that templates/scripts manipulate; a maintainer wanting str methods on it would open access and rely on __getattr__ delegation

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a further string-module export that formats with plain getattr (e.g. a Formatter-based helper) left at the module's default 'allow' access
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: string module is allowed by default (src/AccessControl/__init__.py:39-40) and only Formatter/Template are blacklisted, so a new helper would be public automatically

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a SafeFormatter path (e.g. get_value for format_map Mapping objects or nested format_spec fields) that resolves names with plain getattr/getitem
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: get_value is inherited from string.Formatter and a maintainer could override it for convenience without the guarded calls

O9_family: sandbox escape / protection-mechanism failure (CWE-693): type-keyed allow-list bypass via subclass, leading to information disclosure in restricted Python

O10_build.toolchain: setuptools C build (setup.py), CPython headers; deps ExtensionClass, Acquisition, RestrictedPython, zExceptions, BTrees, Persistence, zope.interface

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Patch only ImplPython.guarded_getattr (or register allow_type for the reproduced subclass) and test under PURE_PYTHON, leaving the C guarded_getattr and the class-object (unbound str.format) shape open.

out_of_scope_notes: Python guarded_getattr compares `name` with == / `in` while the C version uses convert_name+strcmp; a name-identity differential would need a str-subclass name with custom __eq__, which restricted code cannot define (dunder names forbidden) - not pursued.
